~~ONLY `-beta-enabled` is broken, oddly. Not `-beta-features` (runs beta tests) and not `-alpha-beta-enabled.~~

But it's not the tests that are broken, it's the cluster. So we should check the job configuration.

https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-informing#kind-master-alpha-beta-enabled

Actually, it may be that the jobs just haven't caught this yet.

The current run of beta-features looks unhealthy:
https://prow.k8s.io/view/gs/kubernetes-ci-logs/logs/ci-kubernetes-e2e-kind-beta-features/2032237054389129216

Ok yeah no, beta-features is also broken:
https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking#kind-master-beta-features

Maybe we _should_ run -beta-features in presubmit.

Since we run the release-blocking jobs more often, we have a narrower testgrid diff of:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/compare/03e8d8839...4e2bbc78b

So it's definitely due to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137170

/sig node
/wg device-management

/assign @pohly
I need to head out for a bit, and I'm not sure how we want to address this.

I'm going to quickly throw up a test-infra PR to help catch future issues though.
https://github.com/kubernetes/test-infra/pull/36648 to run these jobs on feature gate changes alongside the existing alpha-beta-features
I independently noticed and fixed it in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137704.
